name: Western Desert (Egypt)
transfers: MODIS NDVI 0.090 in a ~2 km sample — barren-surface rehearsal for mobility and dust-adjacent checkout
Air-temperature diurnal swing from NASA POWER for thermal-cycling rehearsal (air↔air vs MEDA)
Slope pending — same 20 m DEM baseline as Jezero USGS + lunar LOLA (compute_slopes_20m.py)
breaks: Earth gravity and atmosphere do not transfer
Illumination / radiation environment is not planetary
Mineralogy zero-weighted until a citable site value exists
Do not treat POWER air ΔT as MODIS land-surface ΔT
tests: Instrument thermal soak / diurnal cycle checkout (air-side matched)
Wheel–soil interaction once 20 m slopes are filled
Ops rehearsal: timed rover shift under thermal stress
scaleNotes: Coarse cell ~0.5°. NDVI: MODIS MOD13Q1 250 m annual mean in a ~2 km box. Slopes: null until LOLA / USGS Jezero / Earth DEM at 20 m baseline. Thermal: NASA POWER T2M air climatology.

gaps.title: Gravity mismatch
gaps.detail: Earth 1 g vs Moon ~1/6 g / Mars ~0.38 g — loads and sinkage do not scale 1:1.

gaps.title: Atmosphere / vacuum
gaps.detail: Convective cooling and pressure effects on Earth invalidate vacuum thermal behavior.

gaps.title: Radiation environment
gaps.detail: Earth magnetosphere and atmosphere shield radiation; planetary surface dose does not transfer.

gaps.title: Air vs ground temperature
gaps.detail: Jezero MEDA diurnal amplitude used here is air (~60 K at 1.45 m). Earth POWER uses T2M air — compare air↔air. MODIS LST is ground and must not be mixed unlabeled.

gaps.title: Vegetation sample scale
gaps.detail: NDVI is a MODIS 250 m point sample in a ~2 km box at the cell centre, not a 0.5° area mean. Bare cover within the cell can differ from the sample.

gaps.title: Biosphere / contamination
gaps.detail: Earth biology and planetary protection constraints are unique to terrestrial tests.
